Package persistence

Class CtrlAnalyze

java.lang.Object
persistence.CtrlAnalyze
public class CtrlAnalyze extends Object
The CtrlAnalyze class is responsible for controlling persistence-related operations on the class Analyze. It's intended to be called by the controller of the persistence. Stores Analyzes in memory and disk through the Cache. IDs are auto-generated if not provided. This class follows the singleton pattern. The CtrlAnalyze::close() method needs to be run manually **before** this class is destructed.
Author:
Artur Leivar (artur.leivar@estudiantat.upc.edu)
